scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:biome && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run check:contracts && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.quality:precommit: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint
scripts.quality:complete: pnpm run quality:precommit && pnpm test && pnpm run size && pnpm run test-e2e && pnpm run docs:build && pnpm run audit
scripts.lint:biome: biome lint packages scripts docs/.vitepress eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts --error-on-warnings
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.tools.json && turbo run typecheck --filter=@ternaus/* && pnpm --filter @example/openapi-fetch-nextjs run check && pnpm --filter @example/js-tools-docs run typecheck
scripts.check:contracts: node scripts/generate-read-write-types.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @ternaus/eslint-plugin-react run check:citation && pnpm --filter @ternaus/eslint-plugin-react run check:rule-documentation && pnpm --filter @ternaus/eslint-plugin-react run check:biome-completeness && pnpm --filter @ternaus/eslint-plugin-react run check:eslint-residual
